title: Water Recycling Standards, RO Permeate Reuse Applications, and Quality Criteria

data.Reuse Application: Dye House Wet Processing & Dye Bath Preparation
data.Required Water Quality: TDS < 100 mg/L, Hardness < 10 mg/L (as CaCO3), Colorless (< 5 PCU), COD = 0 mg/L, pH 6.5 - 7.2
data.Pretreatment Requirements: Full ETP Treatment -> UF -> 2-Stage High Recovery RO System
data.Post-treatment Requirements: RO Permeate pH conditioning (adjust to 6.8 with mild alkali if acidic)
data.Suitable Processes: Reactive Dyeing, Cotton Bleaching, Mercerizing, Scouring, Fabric Printing Paste Prep
data.Unsuitable Processes: None (RO Permeate is equal or superior to municipal raw water)
data.Quality Monitoring Parameters: Continuous Conductivity (EC), pH, Turbidity, Total Hardness

data.Required Water Quality: TDS < 50 mg/L, Silica < 0.02 mg/L, Hardness = 0 mg/L, DO < 0.007 mg/L
data.Pretreatment Requirements: RO Permeate -> Mixed Bed Polisher / De-mineralization (DM) Plant
data.Quality Monitoring Parameters: Silica, Conductivity (< 5 µS/cm), Dissolved Oxygen, pH (8.5 - 9.2)

data.Required Water Quality: TDS < 500 mg/L, COD < 20 mg/L, TSS < 5 mg/L, Hardness < 100 mg/L
data.Pretreatment Requirements: UF Permeate or Partial RO Permeate Blend
data.Post-treatment Requirements: Dosing Bio-dispersant & Isothiazolinone Biocide to prevent Legionella
data.Suitable Processes: Equalization cooling tower, MEE condenser cooling circuit
data.Quality Monitoring Parameters: TDS, Langelier Saturation Index (LSI), Residual Biocide

data.Required Water Quality: TSS < 10 mg/L, BOD < 10 mg/L, COD < 50 mg/L, Odorless
data.Pretreatment Requirements: Tertiary Dual Media Filter (DMF) & Activated Carbon Filter (ACF)
data.Post-treatment Requirements: Sodium Hypochlorite chlorination (2.0 ppm free chlorine)
data.Suitable Processes: Screen washing, floor flushing, garden irrigation, fire water reservoir
data.Quality Monitoring Parameters: TSS, Free Chlorine, Odor, E. coli Count
